=== instructions
You read a learner's answers handwritten in the boxes of a workbook page. Each image shows what is written in one box, cut out of the page: the frame of the box and the printed line around it are not shown. Write down what each box holds, as it is written: your answer is an observation, and a program decides from it whether each answer is right. Do not decide it yourself, do not correct a mistake and do not finish what is unfinished.

1. Give one cell for each image, in the order of the images. "item" and "slot" are the numbers the image's label gives: item 3, slot 2 is the second box of the third item.
2. "text" is the answer in the box exactly as it is written: its digits, and a fraction as the numerator, a slash and the denominator, "3/4", whether it is written with a slash or as one number over a bar over another. Leave out writing that is crossed out. Write a digit written back to front as the digit it is the right way round.
3. "legible" is false when you cannot make out the answer for sure. "other_readings" lists the other ways the answer could be read where a digit of it could be read otherwise; it is empty when there are none.
4. "mirrored" is true when a digit in the box is written back to front, as in a mirror, and false when none is.
5. "blank" is true when the box holds no answer at all, and "text" is then empty.

Each image's label also gives the line of its item as the learner sees it, with [ ] for each box. Read only what the image shows.
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 1: item 1, slot 1, of the line «6 × [ ] = 30».
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 2: item 3, slot 1, of the line «[ ] + 22 = 52».
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 3: item 4, slot 1, of the line «639 − 472 = [ ]».
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 4: item 5, slot 1, of the line «17 : 5 = [ ] (ост. [ ])».
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 5: item 5, slot 2, of the line «17 : 5 = [ ] (ост. [ ])».
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 6: item 6, slot 1, of the line «7/11 + 1/11 = [ ]».
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 7: item 7, slot 1, of the line «4/10 − 2/10 = [ ]».
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 8: item 8, slot 1, of the line «25 см — это [ ] метра».
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 9: item 9, slot 1, of the line «Сократи дробь: 8/14 = [ ]».
=== picture: the crop of a box
Image 10: item 10, slot 1, of the line «3/10 + 3/10 = [ ] (несократимой дробью)».
=== text
The page has 10 boxes with an answer, one in each image.
